title: Overture Maps — Buildings in Current Map View
description: Streams building footprints from the Overture Maps global open dataset filtered by your current QGIS canvas extent.
sql:
-- Query Overture Buildings filtered by current map extent
SELECT 
    id,
    names.primary AS name,
    height,
    num_floors,
    ST_GeomFromWkb(geometry) AS geom
FROM read_parquet('s3://overturemaps-us-west-2/release/2024-02-15-alpha.0/theme=buildings/type=building/*')
WHERE 
    bbox.xmin <= {{BBOX_XMAX}} AND bbox.xmax >= {{BBOX_XMIN}}
    AND bbox.ymin <= {{BBOX_YMAX}} AND bbox.ymax >= {{BBOX_YMIN}}
LIMIT 5000;

title: Overture Maps — Places & POIs in Current View
description: Streams POIs, restaurants, and amenities from Overture Maps matching the current map bounding box.
sql:
-- Query Overture Places / POIs in current map extent
SELECT 
    id,
    names.primary AS name,
    categories.main AS category,
    confidence,
    ST_GeomFromWkb(geometry) AS geom
FROM read_parquet('s3://overturemaps-us-west-2/release/2024-02-15-alpha.0/theme=places/type=place/*')
WHERE 
    bbox.xmin <= {{BBOX_XMAX}} AND bbox.xmax >= {{BBOX_XMIN}}
    AND bbox.ymin <= {{BBOX_YMAX}} AND bbox.ymax >= {{BBOX_YMIN}}
LIMIT 2500;

title: Query Remote GeoParquet via HTTPS
description: Query any public cloud GeoParquet dataset over HTTPS without downloading the full archive.
sql:
-- Query remote GeoParquet directly over HTTPS
SELECT 
    * EXCLUDE (geometry),
    ST_GeomFromWkb(geometry) AS geom
FROM read_parquet('https://data.source.coop/fiboa/us-ca-yolo/yolo_2023.parquet')
LIMIT 1000;

title: Convert CSV Lat/Lon to Spatial Points
description: Instant spatialization of tabular CSV data into QGIS geometry points using ST_Point.
sql:
-- Convert CSV latitude/longitude columns to spatial points
SELECT 
    *,
    ST_Point(longitude, latitude) AS geom
FROM read_csv('path/to/data.csv', header=true)
LIMIT 1000;

title: Spatial Aggregation & Convex Hull
description: Aggregate geometry clusters by category and compute convex hulls.
sql:
-- Aggregate features and calculate cluster envelopes
SELECT 
    category,
    COUNT(*) AS total_features,
    ST_ConvexHull(ST_Union_Agg(geom)) AS geom
FROM source_table
GROUP BY category;

title: Generate Spatial Hexagonal / Circular Grid
description: Generate dynamic geometric grids using DuckDB range generator and ST_Buffer.
sql:
-- Create a procedural grid of polygon cells
SELECT 
    i AS col_idx,
    j AS row_idx,
    ST_Buffer(ST_Point({{BBOX_XMIN}} + i * (({{BBOX_XMAX}} - {{BBOX_XMIN}}) / 10.0), 
                       {{BBOX_YMIN}} + j * (({{BBOX_YMAX}} - {{BBOX_YMIN}}) / 10.0)), 
              (({{BBOX_XMAX}} - {{BBOX_XMIN}}) / 25.0)) AS geom
FROM range(0, 10) t1(i), range(0, 10) t2(j);

title: Inspect File Schema & Column Types
description: Inspect column names, data types, and nullability for any Parquet, GeoPackage, or CSV file.
sql:
-- Inspect schema and columns of any file
DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM read_parquet('https://data.source.coop/fiboa/us-ca-yolo/yolo_2023.parquet');
